problem: Native Word RTF paragraph-layout publication exposed three defects. An undelimited retained control word could merge with following reconstructed text. Equivalent Unicode escape output split parsed runs and was incorrectly rejected despite identical text/formatting. The fallback body span began at a header transport newline and extended through trailing metadata, allowing color/style/info/theme resources to be dropped once the earlier failures were resolved.
changes: Terminate otherwise undelimited opaque alphabetic control words with an ignored line break in both layout and canonical writing. Preserve the exact opaque node bytes, distinguish control symbols and existing space delimiters, and avoid adding a formatting scope inside tracked revisions.

Compare exact visible text and complete Formatting values across run boundaries with an allocation-free paired-byte cursor. Different text, language, revision IDs, script selectors or formatting still fail; lexical Unicode token fragmentation alone no longer does.

Replace layout fallback selection with a bounded, balanced source plan that skips header/trailer destinations and records source offsets of bookmark/break events. Re-emit only events inside the replaced extent, including leading events inside formatting groups. Retained prefix/trailer events remain untouched. Interleaved non-body destinations refuse atomically.

Exclude transport-only CR/LF text from the cached ordinary-body start. Verify font tables, RGB/automatic color identity, styles, information fields, theme and datastore after layout publication, in addition to existing text, paragraph, opaque-node and formatting checks.

Add six native tests and nine focused regressions covering delimiter boundaries, Unicode coverage, header/trailer preservation, source event ownership, metadata refusal, cache boundaries and semantic/resource comparison. Update the native assertion index and feature matrix.

verification_scope.heading_reads: word-math-navigation.rtf exposes 19 body paragraphs. Native title/TOC/H1/H2 use Aptos Display at 56/28/40/32 half-points, with the exact bold, automatic-versus-RGB(15,71,97) color, spacing and keep flags. Numbered items retain physical/hanging indents 360/-360 and 792/-432. These are saved local properties, not a TOC or layout calculation.
verification_scope.script_fonts: word-bidi-eastasia.rtf retains Arial (Arabic), Arial (Hebrew), Hiragino Mincho ProN W3 and Songti SC Light. Selected associated font IDs are 1555,1554,180,345; associated languages are 1025,1037,1025,1025, while primary language is 1033. Explicit local LTR state is distinct from script/language metadata. Canonical writing preserves text, every visible character with its complete Formatting value, paragraph properties, opaque nodes and all checked resources.
verification_scope.run_format_transactions: Native minimal/bidi title runs and the Arabic مرحبا run accept bold, italic, double underline and 28-half-point size batches. Invalid batch selectors stage nothing; a later invalid selector retains earlier staged changes. Every unselected Formatting field, all other visible characters, paragraph properties, opaque bytes/anchors and resources remain exact through save/reopen, forward replay, stale-patch rejection and exact inverse.
verification_scope.body_frame_crud: Create/update/remove frames on native minimal and bidi sources using width 1440 then 960, exact height -720, margin/page anchors, negative horizontal offset -120, vertical offset 240, lock/no-overlap metadata, text distances and Around/Through wrapping. Invalid width retains staged work. Space-before 120 is also authored and cleared. Original text, character coverage, other paragraph values, opaque nodes, fonts, colors, styles, information, theme and datastore survive all commits and exact inverse replay. These frames are Litchi-authored derivatives of immutable native inputs.
verification_scope.native_footer_frames: word-tables-layout.rtf contains two positioned footer PAGE paragraphs: margin/right horizontal placement, paragraph-relative vertical offset 0 and overlay enabled. The ordinary body has no frame. An independent header edit changes exactly HEADER_DEFAULT_002 to HEADER_REVIEWED_002; attempting a dependent footer-text edit refuses without losing that staged header edit. The footer frames, PAGE records, tables, body and all other source bytes remain intact after reopening and inversion.
verification_scope.scope_boundaries: Native math/navigation and table/layout sources keep their existing precise UnsupportedContent refusals for dependent whole-body layout/run-format edits. Metadata resources interleaved inside the required body extent are also explicitly refused instead of dropped. This does not make an unsupported-format claim or substitute for the positive native simple-source and footer-preservation tests.
verification_scope.focused_regressions: Cover alphabetic, signed/numeric, adjacent and already-delimited opaque controls, symbols, grouped controls, unknown destinations and stable canonical output. Unicode-normalized run coverage remains exact, while changed text/bold/language/RSID/script rejects. Header CR/LF does not start the cached body; balanced layout selection preserves raw prefix/trailer resources. Leading/trailing bookmarks and break events are emitted only when owned by the rewritten extent. Equal run references cannot mask changed fonts, information or automatic-versus-explicit palette state.
verification_scope.specification_basis: Read-only research used the supplied RTF 1.9.1 specification, especially pp. 7-9 control-word delimiters, ignored transport line breaks, groups and destination placement. Existing typed frame geometry/validation was reused. No production/test code depends on the research checkout.
verification_scope.limits: No Word reopen, visual layout, glyph shaping, bidi rendering, pagination, field refresh or macro execution was performed. Footer frame/property mutation is not added. Frame CRUD is source-bound and retains its existing durable-patch limitation. Layout publication may change lexical run segmentation while preserving visible text and complete per-character formatting; paragraph marks remain structural.

initial_reproductions.note: Initial native frame creation failed opaque preservation because allowfieldendsel was concatenated with the following RTF/WORD text. Opaque comparison stayed enabled throughout the repair.

After delimiter repair, native bidi layout still failed strict run-by-run comparison. The first mismatch was م versus مرحبا with formats_equal=true; the final comparison proves exact text and all Formatting fields across segment boundaries.

Stronger resource assertions then exposed the pre-existing fallback-span defect: the source had 23 palette entries and the candidate had none. The first source difference was at byte 6746 after the font table; the old extent removed color/style/info and trailing theme groups. The final source planner and resource guard correct this independently.
